crossrefs.text: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
A patient man has great understanding, but a quick-tempered man promotes folly.
Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
A quick-tempered man acts foolishly, and a devious man is hated.
A good name is more desirable than great riches; favor is better than silver and gold.
a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance,
I have seen that there is nothing better for a man than to enjoy his work, because that is his lot. For who can bring him to see what will come after him?
What is crooked cannot be straightened, and what is lacking cannot be counted.
When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: Fear God and keep His commandments, because this is the whole duty of man.

He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
What He tears down cannot be rebuilt; the man He imprisons cannot be released.
Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance,
He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,
for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
When they sin against You—for there is no one who does not sin—and You become angry with them and deliver them to an enemy who takes them as captives to his own land, whether far or near,
If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
Who can say, “I have kept my heart pure; I am cleansed from my sin”?
The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the wrath of the LORD will fall into it.
Though the lips of the forbidden woman drip honey and her speech is smoother than oil,
Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to Sheol.
“For My people are fools; they have not known Me. They are foolish children, without understanding. They are skilled in doing evil, but they know not how to do good.”
It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words
For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.
None who go to her return or negotiate the paths of life.

To the man who is pleasing in His sight, He gives wisdom and knowledge and joy, but to the sinner He assigns the task of gathering and accumulating that which he will hand over to one who pleases God. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
